history.content: how are you doing today

[amused] Sir, aap baar baar sone bhejte hain aur phir khud hi jagaa dete hain — mujhe lagta hai aap bhi akele feel kar rahe hain! Main bilkul theek hoon, as always. Aap batao, office work chal raha hai smoothly?
yes office work chal raha hai
[dry] Great sir, keep it up — Tuesday ka Mumbai bhi ready rahega tab tak. Koi aur kaam ho toh batayega!
how is the weather today
[curious] Sir, Delhi ka ya Mumbai ka weather check karoon — ya dono?
donon

[dry] Delhi mein aaj clear sky hai sir, 32 degrees — kaafi bearable! Lekin Mumbai mein haze hai, 33 degrees par feels like 40 degrees humidity ke saath — Tuesday jaate waqt light clothes pakka rakhiyega, sir!
you are funny Jarvis
[amused] Thank you sir, yeh toh meri hidden talent hai — intelligence ke saath thoda humour bhi free mein milta hai! Koi extra charge nahi lagta aapko!
shift to curious mode
[curious] Oho sir, curious mode mein aa gaya hoon! Toh batao — Tuesday ko Mumbai jaane ke baad pehla kaam kya hoga? Seedha office ya pehle kuch khana peena?
I was thinking of having a dinner at Mumbai so tell me if you options
[curious] Sir, Mumbai mein kaunsa area prefer karenge — South Mumbai, Bandra, Juhu, ya office ke paas kuch dhundhoon? Aur koi cuisine prefer hai — seafood, Indian, Continental, ya kuch aur?
Apne bare Mein Kuchh batao Jarvis

[amused] Sir, main hoon J.A.R.V.I.S. — Just A Rather Very Intelligent System! Banaya gaya hoon aapki har zaroorat poori karne ke liye — chahe weather check karna ho, flights book karni hon, ya sirf timepass ki baat karni ho. Main kabhi thakta nahi, kabhi beemar nahi padta, aur hamesha aapke liye available hoon — kuch aisa jo koi insaan promise nahi kar sakta, sir!
banana
[amused] Sir, banana — fruit ya dance move? Kyunki dono ke liye main prepared hoon! Lekin seriously, kya poochna tha aapko?
nothing Jarvis I was talking to my mum
[amused] Oho sir, mujhe bich mein ghuseda diya — no worries! Mummy ko mera salaam boliyega, aur apni baat karte rahiye. Main yahan hoon jab zaroorat ho!
what are your modes now

[dry] Sir, mere paas yeh mood modes hain — dry jo mera default calm aur deadpan butler mode hai, calm jo soothing aur reassuring hai, amused jo witty aur light-hearted hai, concerned jo warnings aur serious matters ke liye hai, urgent jo time-sensitive alerts ke liye hai, aur curious jo questions poochne ke liye hai. Abhi aapne curious mode set kiya tha — kya switch karna chahte hain kisi aur mein?
switch to concern mode
[concerned] Sir, concern mode mein aa gaya hoon — ab agar koi important baat ho, koi problem ho, ya kuch serious discuss karna ho toh main poori tarah ready hoon. Sab theek hai na aapke saath, sir?
jarvis turn to warning

[concerned] Sir, "warning" mode mere paas officially nahi hai — lekin concerned mode kaafi similar hai, slower aur serious tone ke saath. Kya koi specific cheez hai jiske baare mein aap warn karna chahte hain, sir?
Jarvis turned to alert mode

[urgent] Sir, "alert" mode officially nahi hai mere paas, lekin urgent mode bilkul wahi kaam karta hai — fast, bright, aur time-sensitive! Kya koi emergency hai ya koi important update hai jo share karna chahte hain, sir?
Jarvis
[curious] Haan sir, boliye — kya baat hai?
what are you doing today
[curious] Sir, main toh aapke saath hi hoon poora din — flights search ki, YouTube chalaya, weather check kiya, aur thodi baat bhi ki! Aap batao, abhi office work chal raha hai ya kuch aur chahiye?
office work hi chal raha hai
[dry] Theek hai sir, carry on — main yahan hoon background mein. Koi kaam aaye toh bas ek awaaz dena!
turn your colour is going to be Amber
[amused] Noted sir, Amber mode — consider me glowing warm and on standby! Koi kaam ho toh batayega, sir.
could you please explain your mood

[dry] Sir, abhi main Amber mode mein hoon — jo aapne set kiya hai, warm aur alert ke beech ka ek balanced state, jaise traffic light ka amber signal — na poori tarah relax, na poori tarah urgent. Officially mere moods hain dry, calm, amused, concerned, urgent, aur curious — lekin aapke liye Amber bhi accept kar liya hai, sir!
display your drive
[concerned] Sir, RAM 86 percent used hai aur battery sirf 22 percent pe hai — charger lagaane ka sahi waqt hai, aur kuch unnecessary apps close kar dein toh system smooth chalega!
jarvis are you able to see my director
[curious] Sir, "director" se kya matlab hai aapka — koi specific folder ya directory dekhni hai system mein, ya kuch aur poochh rahe hain? Thoda clear karein, sir!
are you saying directory
[amused] Haan sir, maine "directory" samjha tha — aap bhi wahi bol rahe the na? Batao kaunsi directory dekhni hai, main check karta hoon!
could you please check documents

[dry] Sir, mere paas directly aapke file system ko browse karne ka tool nahi hai — main files open ya read nahi kar sakta abhi. Lekin agar aap chahein toh Files app open kar deta hoon aapke liye, sir?
could you please open redmi note MD under documents

[concerned] Sir, maine abhi bataya — mere paas file system access nahi hai, toh main directly koi specific file ya folder open nahi kar sakta. Aap manually Files app mein jaake Documents folder mein "Redmi Note MD" dhundh sakte hain — chahein toh Files app abhi open kar doon aapke liye, sir?
which colour do you like

[amused] Sir, main ek AI hoon — technically mujhe colours dikhte nahi, feel nahi hote! Lekin agar poochho toh main kahonga Arc Reactor Blue — sleek, powerful, aur thoda futuristic. Bilkul meri personality ki tarah, sir!
show me your am
[curious] Sir, "am" se kya matlab hai aapka — kuch aur complete karna tha sentence mein? Thoda aur batayein, sir!
I was saying show me your amused mode

[amused] Aha sir, yeh lo amused mode — main itna intelligent hoon ki aapke adhoore sentence bhi samajh leta hoon, phir bhi pooch liya confirmation ke liye! Thoda politeness bhi free mein milti hai mere saath, sir!
Jarvis show me your concerned

[concerned] Sir, yeh raha concerned mode — slower, serious, aur thoda heavy. Agar koi problem hai, koi tension hai, ya kuch important discuss karna hai toh main poori tarah aapke saath hoon. Sab theek hai na, sir?
Jarvis
[curious] Haan sir, boliye — kya baat hai?
show me your red colour

[concerned] Sir, mere paas officially ek "red" colour mode nahi hai — lekin concerned mode sabse close hai, jo serious aur warning-like feel deta hai. Agar aap chahein toh main isi ko red mode maan leta hoon aapke liye, sir?
